name: omnibase/docs
description: The documentation, read from Markdown files: a manual in the back office, and public manuals - one per package, read in its repository, one version per branch - with a search (Typesense, or the pages' own index).

suggest.glitchr/typesense-bundle: The public manuals' search in Typesense (wikidoc.search.typesense); without it the pages' own index answers.
suggest.omnibase/admin: The manual in the back office (/docs).
suggest.symfony/process: wikidoc:sync: the documentation of the branches that are not checked out (needs the git binary).
suggest.tempest/highlight: Colours the public manuals' code blocks on the server (PHP 8.4).
